summary: Pinned Assetrizz sci-fi and hand-painted fantasy terrain, expanded enemy/character strips, NPC portraits, region backdrops, ornate icons, six original Gloamforge weapon views and Cinder/Hollowmere theme variants.
useWhen: Select a theme/assetrizz role for shooter or canvas presentations using the standard theme keys; Hollowmere also consumes public Assetrizz backdrops, portraits and UI icons.
limitations: Theme texture painters use the shooter/canvas semantic vocabulary; UI backdrops/portraits/icons are public-size files, not 64px world tiles.
Assetrizz art provenance is original, generated for Kyle Durepos; weapon renders and synthesized sound have separate original provenance.
The new region backdrops and expanded enemy strips do not imply a general terrain or animation-graph system.
